ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #14
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 38
   C. 22
   D. 88

2. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 11
   C. 121
   D. 122

3. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 10
   C. 25
   D. 5

4. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 49
   C. 14
   D. 7

5. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 10
   C. 40
   D. 4

6. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 10

7. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 6x
   D. 12x

8. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 40 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 43
   C. 41
   D. 31

9. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 23
   C. 46
   D. 120

10. What is √64? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 32
   C. 8
   D. 64

11. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 29
   C. 3
   D. 28

12. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 27.7
   C. 27.6
   D. 27

13. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. 2/2
   C. They are equal
   D. 1/4

14. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 169
   C. 13
   D. 170

15. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 36
   C. 81
   D. 90

16. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 10 000 m²
   B. 100 m²
   C. 100 000 m²
   D. 1000 m²

17. Solve for x: x + 9 = 21. (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 21
   C. 9
   D. 12

18. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 20
   B. 1
   C. 21
   D. 9

19. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 24
   C. 48
   D. 144

20. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 82
   C. 9
   D. 81

21. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 19.7
   C. 19.6
   D. 25

22. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.7
   B. 23
   C. 29
   D. 23.6

23. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 31.6
   C. 37
   D. 31.7

24. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 31

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
